overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's December 14 amendment of the December 15 notice was timely under the chair-anticipation rule, and the topic notice, though could have been more detailed, was adequate.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board amended the December 15, 2010 agenda on December 13 and posted it December 14, too late for the 48-hour notice requirement.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acted appropriately when it updated the meeting notice with the new topic the next morning, December 14, 2010.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 15, 2010 meeting notice, listing a 'Continued Review' of legal services respondents, was too vague to meet Open Meeting Law requirements.
allegations.key_passage: but it was sufficient to inform the public of what the Board was considering.
